## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] I tested the changed workflow locally where practical.
- [ ] The change follows the development contract and keeps interface copy limited to useful actions, state, and recovery.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, cookies, `.env` files, private URLs, downloaded media, or other sensitive/local-only data.
- [ ] I did not include real media titles, media URLs, channel/account names, post/video IDs, or other identifiable source-content details in this PR, its commits, tests, screenshots, or logs.
- [ ] The change preserves the relevant security boundary: loopback checks for the browser reference; restricted native commands and owned media access with no localhost application server for desktop.
- [ ] Desktop claims identify actual native validation and unresolved platform gates; an HTML/browser preview is not presented as the desktop application.
- [ ] The change does not add or encourage DRM, authentication, paywall, or access-control bypasses.
